content:
I'll look at the actual repo slice before answering — the `dependsOn` wiring and prune settings determine most of this.

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
Most of these questions hinge on two things that are *declared in the repo*, not inferable from the stack name: whether Flux `Kustomization`s have `prune: true`, and whether ACK resources carry a deletion policy annotation. I'll read those rather than assume.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`


<invoke name="Bash">
<parameter name="command">find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type d -name 'knr-ops' -print 2>/dev/null | head -20</parameter>
<parameter name="description">Locate knr-ops stack dir</parameter>
</invoke>
<invoke name="Bash">
<parameter name="command">ls</parameter>
<parameter name="description">List root</parameter>
</invoke>


./golden-base/knr-ops
